senses.gloss: ज्येष्ठ- + आश्रम ज्येष्ठ- + आश्रम, adj. being in the most eminent order, Man. 3, 78.

ज्येष्ठ ज्येष्ठ, i. e. ज्या + इष्ठ,
 I. superl. of प्रशस्य and वृद्ध (cf. ज्यायंस्), f. ठा,
 1. Most excellent, Man. 9, 123.
 2. Eldest, Man. 9, 126; Daśak. in Chr. 184, 12.
 II. m.
 1. An elder brother, Man. 4, 184.
 2. = ज्यैष्ठ, [] The name of a month, Rājat. 1, 220.
 III. f. ठा.
 1. The name of a lunar station, Rām. 6, 86, 43.
 2. Misfortune, Bhāg. P. 1, 17, 32.
 --Comp.
ज्येष्ठतर ज्येष्ठ + तर, comparat. One of the elder ones, Pañc. 243, 18.

ज्येष्ठता ज्येष्ठ + ता. f.
 1. Superiority, Hariv. 7164.
 2. Primogeniture, Man. 9, 134.
ज्येष्ठत्व ज्येष्ठ + त्व, n. Primogeniture, MBh. 1, 8372.
ज्येष्ठा- + मूल ज्येष्ठा- + मूल, m. the month Jyaiṣṭha, MBh. 13, 4609.
ज्येष्ठ- + वर्ण ज्येष्ठ- + वर्ण, m. a Brāhmaṇa, MBh. 13, 6571.
ज्येष्ठ- + वृत्ति ज्येष्ठ- + वृत्ति, adj. acting as an elder brother ought to act, Man. 9, 110.

ज्येष्ठ- + सामन् ज्येष्ठ- + सामन्,
 I. n. the name of a particular song (of the Sāma- Veda), Man. 3, 185.
 II. m. one who sings this song, Yājñ. 1, 219.
